choose_language: Welcome to HighGround. Choose your language.
location_prompt: Share the shop location (preferred), or use /address followed by its public business address. Only public shop addresses are sent to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service; do not submit private or confidential information.
location_invalid: Please share a valid location, or a public shop address using /address.
address_confirm:
Is this your shop's location? {address}
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Confirm before continuing.
address_unavailable: The address could not be uniquely located. Share the shop location or try a more specific public address.
shop_type_prompt: What kind of shop is it? For example, mini-market, workshop or eatery.
floor_prompt: Is the shop on the ground floor or an upper floor?
vehicle_prompt: Does the shop have a vehicle?
worker_prompt: Would you like a worker to receive alerts too? They must start the bot and consent themselves. Choose invite or skip.
invalid_input: That answer was not accepted. Please try again using the requested format or choices.
registered: {shop_name} is registered. Provisional risk score: {score}/100. Inventory value and river/past-flood exposure are unknown and are not credited yet. This is not a safety assessment. Use /invite to invite one worker.
invite_link:
Send this private, one-hour invitation to your worker: {link}
They must choose their language and explicitly agree. It can be used once.
invite_again: Use /invite to create a fresh private worker invitation.
invite_unavailable: A worker invitation is unavailable. Complete your shop registration first, or keep the existing worker.
join_prompt: Do you agree to receive alerts for {shop_name}?
join_expired: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Ask the shop owner for a new invitation.
joined: You have joined {shop_name} as a worker alert recipient.
join_declined: You have not joined the shop. No alerts will be sent to you for it.
inventory_unavailable: Inventory is unavailable; no stock values are estimated.
vehicle_action_target: Move {vehicle_type} towards listed parking {parking_name} by action target {deadline}, only if conditions permit.
action_target_note: Action targets are not predicted flood-arrival times.
listed_destination_line: Listed destination: {name} {route_link}. Availability and route conditions are unverified.
danger_destination: ⚠️ DANGER: Flooding is reaching your area. Leave now and move to higher ground. Do not stop to record video or move stock. Listed destination: {safe_point_name} {route_link}. Availability and route conditions are unverified. Call 999 in an emergency.
danger_no_destination: ⚠️ DANGER: Flooding is reaching your area. Leave now and move to higher ground. Do not stop to record video or move stock. No listed destination is available. Call 999 in an emergency.
danger_sim_destination:
SIMULATION
⚠️ DANGER: Flooding is reaching your area. Leave now and move to higher ground. Do not stop to record video or move stock. Listed destination: {safe_point_name} {route_link}. Availability and route conditions are unverified. Call 999 in an emergency.
danger_sim_no_destination:
SIMULATION
⚠️ DANGER: Flooding is reaching your area. Leave now and move to higher ground. Do not stop to record video or move stock. No listed destination is available. Call 999 in an emergency.
situation_watch: Early flood concern has been reported.
situation_warning: A flood warning applies to this area.
vehicle_target_unavailable: Vehicle action target for {vehicle_type}: {deadline}. Parking information is unavailable; no destination is recommended.
warning_intro_actions: ⚠️ Warning: {reason} Review the action targets below.
warning_distance: Reported event: approximately {distance_m} m from this shop.
parking_destination_line: Previously designated parking ({year}): {name} {route_link}. Current opening and route conditions are unconfirmed.
shelter_destination_line: Listed evacuation centre: {name} {route_link}. Current opening and route conditions are unconfirmed.
higher_ground_destination_line: Listed higher ground (unverified): {name} {route_link}. Availability and route conditions are unverified.
parking_level_unknown: Minimum parking level is unconfirmed; check locally.
parking_unavailable: No listed parking destination is available.
shelter_unavailable: No listed evacuation destination is available.
photo_registration_required: Register your shop with /start before sending a flood photo.
photo_confirm_at_shop: Is this photo at your registered shop?
photo_share_location: Share the location where this photo was taken. We will ask you to confirm it.
photo_confirm_shared_location: Is this the location where the photo was taken?
photo_rate_limited: One flood report per shop is allowed every 10 minutes. Please wait before reporting again.
photo_invalid: This photo could not be accepted. Please send a supported image.
media_oversize: The file is too large. Send a shorter or compressed clip of no more than 20 MB.
photo_unavailable: The photo report could not be completed. Please try again later.
photo_recorded: Report recorded. Assessment confidence: {confidence}. Neighbor event: {level}. This does not authenticate the scene.
photo_rejected: The image does not provide suitable evidence for a current flood alert.
photo_stale: This report is too old for a current flood alert.
photo_location_invalid: Please share valid coordinates for where this photo was taken.
inventory_request: When there is no active Danger, send a 30–45 second shop walkthrough video (20 MB or less). Only visible goods can be estimated. Use /refresh to update inventory without registering again.
inventory_invalid: This video metadata is unsupported. Send a native MP4 video with a valid duration.
inventory_oversize: The video exceeds 20 MB. When there is no active Danger, send a shorter or compressed 30–45 second clip.
inventory_complete: Visible inventory recorded. Replacement values and quantities are estimates. If water comes, lift these first:
inventory_total: All visible items: estimated total RM{value_rm}. Visual confidence: {confidence}.
integrity_verified: File integrity verified: stored bytes match their recorded SHA-256 and completed evidence ledger. This does not verify recording authenticity.
integrity_pending: File integrity verification is pending. Recording authenticity is unverified.
stock_recorded: Stock lifting recorded as self-reported completion of the displayed estimated snapshot.
stock_already_recorded: This displayed stock snapshot was already recorded.
inventory_processing_unavailable: The upload could not be assessed. No new inventory or valuation is confirmed. Try /refresh later only when there is no active Danger.
recovery_owner_required: Only the registered shop owner can start or change a recovery report.
recovery_baseline_required: A visible baseline inventory is required before a recovery report. Use /inventory when there is no active Danger.
recovery_declaration: Declare that the flood is over with the button or /report confirm. This is your declaration, not independent proof of clearance. /cancel exits this workflow.
recovery_declare_button: Flood is over — I declare recovery
recovery_after_request: When there is no active Danger, send a 30–45 second after-flood video (20 MB or less). Your frozen baseline will be preserved. Optional water-line photo can be attached; /cancel exits.
recovery_blocked: Recovery is not cleared. Official, unknown or simulated Danger requires its authorized recovery path.
recovery_processing_unavailable: The recovery estimate is unavailable. Retry this same upload later, or use /report to begin a new attempt with another video when there is no active Danger.
recovery_complete: Recovery report recorded with private evidence. This is an estimate, not an insurance valuation. Use /waterline to attach an optional water-line photo, or /inventory for a new baseline.
recovery_estimate: Assessed estimated loss: RM{value_rm}. Unknown items are excluded.
recovery_estimate_unavailable: Loss estimate unavailable: no baseline items could be assessed. Unknown loss is not zero.
recovery_photo_received: Water-line photo attached as private evidence at your confirmed shop location. No water depth or recording authenticity is inferred.
recovery_photo_request: When there is no active Danger, send an optional water-line photo from your confirmed shop location. /cancel exits.
recovery_exited: Recovery input closed. Use /report to start again.
card_inventory_missing: Visible inventory unavailable. No property value is estimated.
card_opening_unknown: Current opening and route conditions are unverified.
card_no_parking: No listed parking is available in this lookup.
card_no_shelter: No listed evacuation centre is available in this lookup.
card_footer: Save this image — it works without signal.
card_map_label: Schematic pins — not a route or safety guarantee.
card_unavailable: The offline card is unavailable. No image delivery is confirmed. Try /card again when there is no active Danger.
card_owner_required: Only the registered shop owner can request an offline card.
policy_owner_required: Only the registered shop owner can use /policy.
policy_disclosure: Before uploading: HighGround deletes its stored policy copy after extraction by default, retaining only extracted fields and a SHA-256 receipt. Choose Keep before your first document to retain a successful extraction privately. Failed or cancelled extraction deletes HighGround’s stored copy even if you chose Keep. This does not delete your Telegram message or copies processed by external providers. Send one PDF or up to 5 policy photos (20 MB total). Photos require Done; use Cancel to stop.
policy_keep_selected: Keep selected for successful extraction. Send one PDF or up to 5 policy photos; use Done after the last photo. Failed or cancelled extraction still deletes HighGround’s stored copy.
policy_choice_frozen: Your retention choice was frozen at the first accepted document. To choose Keep now, cancel and start /policy again, then re-upload.
policy_photo_received: Policy photo received privately. Send any remaining policy pages, then choose Done. No extraction has started.
policy_invalid: Document not accepted. Use one PDF or up to 5 readable policy photos, at most 20 MB total. Do not mix PDF and photos. Cancel and start /policy again to replace the documents.
policy_not_disclosed: Start /policy and read the retention notice before uploading policy documents.
policy_pending: Policy processing is still in progress. Try Done again later or Cancel.
policy_failed: Policy extraction is unavailable. HighGround’s stored copies are being deleted, including any Keep selection. Start /policy again to re-upload.
policy_cancelled: Policy intake cancelled. HighGround’s stored copies are being deleted; Keep applies only to successful extraction.
policy_deleted: HighGround’s stored policy copy deleted. Extracted fields and SHA-256 receipts remain. This does not delete the Telegram message or external provider copies.
policy_delete_pending: Deletion of HighGround’s stored policy copy is pending. It is unavailable for viewing and will be retried.
policy_result: Document extraction completed. Insurer: {insurer}. Type: {policy_type}. Quoted wording: {quote}. Flood wording: {coverage}. Stock/contents limit: {limit}. Excess: {excess}. Expiry: {expiry}. Comparison: {comparison}. This does not establish current coverage or a guaranteed payout. Scope may differ from the inventory replacement-price estimate; excess is not added to cover. Check with your insurer.
policy_retained: HighGround’s stored policy copy is retained privately under your pre-upload Keep choice. Only the owner can access it; use Delete copy to remove it.
policy_copy_button: Send kept page {page} to this Telegram chat
policy_cover_yes: Flood cover is indicated by the quoted wording; current coverage is unverified
policy_cover_no: The quoted wording explicitly excludes flood; check with your insurer
policy_cover_unclear: Flood cover is unclear from the supplied document
policy_gap: Estimated stock/contents limit shortfall ≈RM {gap}, compared with frozen inventory estimate ≈RM {estimate}
policy_no_gap: No estimated stock/contents limit shortfall against the frozen inventory estimate ≈RM {estimate}; coverage and scope remain unverified
policy_not_covered: Explicit flood exclusion is indicated. Ask your insurer whether flood or special-perils add-on cover is appropriate
policy_unclear: The supplied document does not establish flood cover. Ask your insurer about flood or special-perils add-on cover
policy_expired: The document expiry date is past; current coverage is unknown
policy_baseline_unavailable: No usable frozen inventory replacement-price estimate; shortfall is unknown
policy_limit_unavailable: No unambiguous MYR stock/contents insured limit; shortfall is unknown
policy_expiry_unknown: Expiry is unknown; any estimated comparison does not establish current cover
